din464.source: DIN 464 high knurled thumb screw (Raendelschraube, hohe Form), M6: knurled head diameter dk=24.0, knurled head height k=5.0, raised on a reduced collar/shoulder of diameter ds=12.0; total head height h=15.0, so collar_h = h - k = 10.0 (h and k are both tabulated; the difference is arithmetic, not a new number). Confirmed vs fasteners.eu DIN 464 table (M6: dk=24 nom, ds=12 nom=max, h=15 nom, k=5 nom=max) + Aspen Fasteners 'Metric DIN 464 Knurled Thumb Screws, High Type' spec PDF (identical M6 column). Both tables cover M1-M10 only -- DIN 464 has NO M12 row -- so the base is drawn at M6, matching the sibling DIN 653 base (same knurled head dk=24/k=5; DIN 464 is that head raised on the collar). d_shank=6.0 is the M6 major diameter (envelope-only, no drawn thread). length=20.0 REPRESENTATIVE (common M6 stock length; the tabulated l series includes 20). head_chamfer=0.5 REPRESENTATIVE 45-degree top-rim break, consistent with the tabulated edge-chamfer series c=0.3-0.6; tip_chamfer=1.0 REPRESENTATIVE 45-degree lead. The knurl itself is omitted (fine feature, like the thread -- same envelope convention as knurled_nut/knurled_screw).

din464p.source: DIN 464 M6, app image-variant key -- identical high-form knurled-thumb-screw envelope (dk=24, k=5 on the ds=12 collar), aliases the din464 base.
